surveys.title: Flash Eurobarometer 585 – Youth and Democracy (Greece / EL column)
surveys.population: Young people aged 15-30 resident in Greece

questions.text: In your opinion, which of the following are most important for delivering results in policies aimed at young people? Select up to three options.
options: Goals that address the real issues faced by young people
Working together across all levels - local, regional, national, and EU
Making sure young people and youth organisations have a say in decisions
Ensuring young people know about policies and opportunities
Providing financial support for youth programmes and initiatives
Making decisions using facts and research
Ensuring policies are actually carried out and reviewed properly
Connecting different areas of policy that affect young people
questions.notes: Multiple response: shares are percent of respondents mentioning each option; columns do not sum to 100. Scripting: maximum three answers; items randomised. Population aged 15-30 only (online panel, CAWI). intlValues are other Member States' published values (integers), aligned with options; EU27 average and EL deliberately omitted.

questions.text: In the last 12 months, have you learned anything new about the following topics?
options: Democratic processes, political participation and institutions
Media and digital literacy and recognising disinformation

questions.text: How did you learn about these topics?
options: In a school or university (courses, extracurricular activities)

Through discussions with your family or friends
At public events or awareness raising campaigns

Boycotting or buying certain products for political, ethical or environmental reasons
Participating in student or youth organisations
Taking part in a public consultation on proposed political initiatives (online or offline), including in the EU Youth Dialogue or the European Citizens Panels
Engaging in social media by expressing my opinion, using hashtags or changing my profile picture for example
